plugins.name: velog
plugins.description: Read and write Velog (velog.io), the Korean developer blogging platform. Browse, search, trending, and blog stats work with no auth. Writing defaults to drafts and private posts — public publishing is opt-in at install. Also renders diagrams, sequence diagrams, and cover images for your posts and uploads them (needs local Chrome). 벨로그 글을 읽고 쓰고, 다이어그램과 시퀀스 다이어그램과 표지도 그려서 올립니다.
